:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- set_prolog_flag(double_quotes, atom).

read_line(Line) :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, Cs),
    ( Cs == end_of_file -> Line = ""
    ; atom_codes(Line, Cs)
    ).

main :-
    read_line(NLine),
    ( NLine == "" -> true
    ; atom_number(NLine, N),
      read_grid(N, Grid),
      solve(Grid, 0, 0, N, Result),
      atom_codes(Result, Codes),
      format("~s~n", [Codes])
    ).

read_grid(0, []) :- !.
read_grid(N, [Row|Rows]) :-
    N > 0,
    read_line(Line),
    atom_codes(Line, Row),
    N1 is N - 1,
    read_grid(N1, Rows).

solve(Grid, R, C, Size, Result) :-
    nth0(R, Grid, Row),
    nth0(C, Row, First),
    check_same(Grid, R, C, Size, First),
    !,
    Result = First.
solve(Grid, R, C, Size, Result) :-
    Half is Size // 2,
    R1 is R + Half,
    C1 is C + Half,
    solve(Grid, R, C, Half, TL),
    solve(Grid, R, C1, Half, TR),
    solve(Grid, R1, C, Half, BL),
    solve(Grid, R1, C1, Half, BR),
    Result = [0'(, TL, TR, BL, BR, 0')].

check_same(_, _, _, 0, _) :- !.
check_same(Grid, R, C, Size, First) :-
    nth0(R, Grid, Row),
    nth0(C, Row, First),
    !,
    R1 is R + 1,
    check_same(Grid, R1, C, Size, First).
check_same(Grid, R, C, Size, First) :-
    nth0(R, Grid, Row),
    between(0, Size, J),
    J < Size,
    Cj is C + J,
    nth0(Cj, Row, V),
    V == First,
    !,
    fail.
```

    between(1, Size, J),
